text:
Rhea (Growth): Quick sync 1) we need final web copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages, 2) a launch blog that links to each mode, and 3) a webinar gating the full benchmark kit. Primary goal: capture mode intent and route leads correctly.
Oli (PMM): Keep the opening thesis tight: \"Serving shapes product economics\". Problem statement -> three mode promises -> gated benchmarks. Developer-first tone.
June (Content): Hero candidates: Hosted: "Get inference running in minutes." Dedicated: "Commit to predictable throughput." Private: "Keep inference inside your network." Subheads will call out speed / predictability / compliance.
Mark (Design): I'll produce three hero comps and a benchmark teaser module. No raw public numbers  use "verified performance profiles" teaser and push the full kit behind the webinar. Creating A/B art for speed-first vs cost-first headlines.
Carmen (Sales Ops): Routing matrix: Hosted CTAs -> self-serve funnel + product nurture; Dedicated CTAs -> AE queue "Reserved-Enterprise"; Private CTAs -> security intake form then AE. Add hidden CTA param mode_hint so clicks map even if form incomplete.
launch-bot: Note: publishing the webinar page will auto-create HubSpot campaign id=tri_mode_launch_2026 and append utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch to demo CTAs. It will create form fields: mode_interest, monthly_tokens_bucket, primary_use_case.
June (Content): CTA microcopy: Hosted: "Start free  no card"; Dedicated: "Reserve capacity  talk to sales"; Private: "Request private eval  security first". Under-hero bullets: latency | unit cost | deployment modes.
Oli (PMM): For public pages use conservative benchmark language: "verified performance profiles" and invite people to the gated kit for detailed methodology and plots. Webinar will present reproducible plots and throughput stories.
Rhea (Growth): A/B test plan: run headline A/B on Hosted + Dedicated for 10 days. Primary KPI = demo clicks + webinar signups. Secondary = time-on-page and activation rate for Hosted.
Mark (Design): I'll tag CTA components with data-cta-id and include hidden param wiring. Comps by EOD. June, keep verbs consistent across modes (Start / Reserve / Request).
Carmen (Sales Ops): Workflow: Dedicated/Private registrants flagged with tokens >10M get AE slack alerts + HubSpot tasks within 24h. Hosted signups enter automated onboarding. I'll map AE queues after copy freeze.
June (Content): Draft structure for the launch post: 1) problem in 120 words, 2) three mode summaries, 3) two benchmark teases, 4) webinar CTA + gated kit. Also include a one-line social blurb.
Rhea (Growth): Timeline: copy freeze tomorrow 11am PT, design comps by 6pm, QA Wed, soft launch Friday. I'll consolidate the runbook at freeze and open Asana tasks. Last call for edits. :white_check_mark:
